run_flux_kontext_pipeline: run the FluxKontextPipeline to generate images from a prompt and reference image with multiple_images support
encode_flux_kontext_prompt: encode text prompts into T5 and CLIP embeddings using FluxKontextPipeline.encode_prompt method
prepare_flux_kontext_latents: prepare packed latents and image latents for FluxKontextPipeline with multiple reference images
preprocess_flux_kontext_images: preprocess multiple reference images to tensor format with preferred Kontext resolutions
calculate_flux_shift: calculate the shift parameter for scheduler timestep calculation based on image sequence length
